policy: Public game labels are authoritative for digital appearance identity. Physical catalog records may support the same scene/accessory family, but exact release equivalence remains separate unless the physical entry independently encodes the same distinguishing state.

records.reason: Silver Cape is an explicit Skywalker Saga appearance. Current supported physical Padmé records do not independently identify a silver-cape release, so preserve this game outfit rather than mapping it to generic Padmé/Queen Amidala figures.

physical_episode9_family.catalog_name: Finn - Medium Nougat Jacket, Dark Blue Legs with Holster

records.reason: Kijimi Coat is an explicit game variant. Brickset confirms a 2019 Episode IX Finn physical release, but its catalog description does not identify the Kijimi coat state; use sw1066 only as the Episode IX character/outfit family pending visual comparison.

The game explicitly distinguishes the orange handmaiden appearance. Current physical Padmé candidates do not independently encode that orange handmaiden costume, so do not substitute Queen Amidala or generic Padmé records.

The public roster identifies Old - Flashback as a distinct Luke state. The current physical candidates are later 2023/2025 Luke releases and cannot source a 2022 game asset; retain the flashback state as digital-specific until a pre-game matching physical release is independently established.

physical_candidate.catalog_name: Luke Skywalker (Dagobah, Tan Tank Top, Backpack)

records.reason: The public game variant is Yoda Backpack. Set 75208 independently supplies Dagobah Luke with a backpack plus Yoda, and Brickset's review explicitly notes that Luke carries Yoda on that backpack. This strongly verifies the physical component/state family while exact digital texture equivalence remains visual pending.
